subject.title: Feature: force media delivery as document attachment (e.g. #doc)

question: Should OpenClaw add force-document behavior beyond the current per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` knobs, and should that public contract be `MEDIA:#doc`, a channel-level default, or no broader contract for now?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 already solve explicit per-call sends, while the remaining request creates either new model-facing syntax or new channel config/default behavior that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep Per-Call Canonical
options.body: Keep `--force-document` and `asDocument` as the supported contract for now, and require a sponsored narrower proposal before adding syntax or config defaults.

options.title: Add `MEDIA:#doc` Syntax
options.body: Define exact fragment parsing and media-kind semantics in the shared media pipeline, then thread it through affected delivery paths with tests and live proof.

options.title: Add Channel Default
options.body: Design a default-off per-channel or per-account setting with explicit per-call override semantics, upgrade docs, and proof that existing default behavior remains intact.

recommendation.title: Keep Per-Call Canonical
recommendation.body: Keep `--force-document` and `asDocument` as the supported contract for now, and require a sponsored narrower proposal before adding syntax or config defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main code and release provenance for the affected shared outbound and channel surfaces route through this recent area history.
